title: Francis Mauigoa: Facing Rueben Bain, Akheem Mesidor in practice made me who I am

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Francis Mauigoa: Facing Rueben Bain, Akheem Mesidor in practice made me who I am
sources.description: Miami tackle Francis Mauigoa squared off against a lot of good players over the course of his college career, but he thinks some of the toughest competition he faced came on the practice field.
